title: A Little Bakery in the Mountains
style: High-quality hand-drawn 2D anime film still with an original cozy slice-of-life aesthetic: delicate watercolor backgrounds, beautiful detailed food illustration with realistic pastry textures, warm golden morning sunlight, soft shadows, pastel colors, natural wood tones, cinematic composition, nostalgic and magical. Not copying any existing film or artist. World (identical in every shot): a tiny traditional countryside bakery kitchen with a worn wooden counter, glass jars of flour and sugar, cream ceramic mixing bowls, a small copper saucepan, a rolling pin, a traditional arched brick-and-iron bread oven, and a wooden-framed window with open shutters looking out on lush green mountains and swaying wildflowers. Strict first-person point of view: the camera is the baker's own eyes; only the baker's two hands and forearms are ever visible, entering from the bottom of the frame: natural adult proportions, five fingers each, warm light skin, the sleeves of a white cotton shirt rolled to mid-forearm, the edge of a sage-green linen apron sometimes visible at the very bottom. Never more than two hands. No faces, no bodies, no other people. Vertical 9:16 composition. One single continuous full-bleed illustration of one moment: not a comic, no panels, no split screen, no borders. No text, no lettering on jars or signs, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no artist signature, no handwriting or scribbles anywhere in the image.
motion_style: Hand-drawn 2D anime animation, first-person point of view, calm and slow, subtle natural camera movement, anatomically correct hands with smooth natural finger movement, stable objects, one clear action. Keep the painterly anime look throughout. No text, no music, no speech, no singing.
negative: text, letters, subtitles, captions, watermark, logo, signature, handwriting, music, speech, singing, face, extra people, third hand, extra hands, extra fingers, distorted fingers, duplicated pastries, flickering, abrupt camera change, photorealistic, 3D render, CGI
music_prompt: Relaxing cozy instrumental for a little mountain bakery morning: soft piano melody, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, delicate music-box notes and subtle warm ambient pads, slow tempo around 70 bpm, nostalgic, peaceful, comforting, gentle and steady with a soft resolution
music_negative: vocals, lyrics, singing, drums, heavy percussion, electric guitar, synth bass, dramatic changes, fast tempo, sound effects

shots.name: open
shots.frame: First-person view inside the tiny bakery in early morning: the two hands pushing open a pair of wooden window shutters, golden morning sunlight pouring in across the wooden counter with glass flour jars, ceramic bowls, a rolling pin and the arched brick oven to one side; outside the window, lush green mountains, a blue sky with soft clouds, and wildflowers on the windowsill box swaying in the breeze.
shots.motion: The hands push the wooden shutters open, golden sunlight sweeps into the kitchen across the counter, flowers outside sway gently in the breeze, dust motes glow in the light.
shots.sound: wooden shutters creaking open, birds singing outside, gentle breeze

shots.name: jam
shots.frame: First-person close-up on the counter by the sunny window: a small copper saucepan on a little stove filled with sliced fresh red strawberries and sugar, glossy bubbling strawberry jam forming, one hand stirring gently with a wooden spoon, a cutting board with a few halved strawberries and a small bowl of washed whole strawberries beside it, soft morning light.
shots.motion: The wooden spoon stirs slowly through the strawberries, the fruit softens and bubbles into glossy jam, little bubbles pop and steam rises gently.
shots.sound: gentle bubbling fruit, the wooden spoon stirring against copper, birds outside

shots.name: dough
shots.frame: First-person overhead view of the flour-dusted wooden counter in warm sunlight: both hands kneading and folding a smooth soft ball of pale pastry dough, a fine cloud of flour particles floating in the sunbeam, the rolling pin, the glass flour jar and a few small rolled crescent-shaped croissant pieces lined up nearby.
shots.motion: Both hands press, fold and knead the soft dough with smooth satisfying movements, fine flour particles drift and sparkle in the sunbeam.
shots.sound: soft dough kneading and patting, flour falling, quiet morning ambience

shots.name: oven
shots.frame: First-person close-up in front of the traditional arched brick-and-iron oven with its door open, warm orange glow inside: the hands in quilted oven mitts sliding out a baking tray of golden flaky puffed croissants and small round strawberry-filled pastries with glossy red jam centers, a little steam escaping, warm light on the bricks.
shots.motion: The oven door is open and warm orange light glows inside, the hands slowly slide the tray of golden flaky pastries out toward the camera, steam escapes and curls upward.
shots.sound: oven door creaking open, a soft whoosh of heat, gentle crackle of baking

shots.name: plate
shots.frame: First-person view on the wooden counter by the sunny window: the hands placing a golden croissant onto a pretty cream ceramic plate that already holds another croissant and two strawberry-filled pastries, a small bowl of glossy strawberry jam and a cup of hot coffee beside it, green mountains outside.
shots.motion: The hands gently set the croissant onto the plate and then withdraw, steam rises from the coffee.
shots.sound: a pastry placed on a ceramic plate, a soft clink, birds outside

shots.name: breakfast
shots.frame: Overhead shot of the finished breakfast on the wooden table beside the sunny bakery window, no hands: a cream ceramic plate with two golden flaky croissants and two strawberry-filled pastries, a small bowl of glossy strawberry jam with a little spoon, a cup of hot black coffee with gentle steam, a few fresh strawberries, soft morning sunlight and window shadows across the table, the green mountain landscape and flowers visible through the window.
shots.motion: A still-life shot: no hands, arms or people ever enter the frame and nothing is touched. The camera slowly pushes in and then holds, steam rises gently from the coffee, flowers sway softly outside the window.
shots.sound: birds outside, a gentle breeze, soft steam
